description: An assistant principal must approve the operating plan for a new school food pantry, including storage controls, allergy labeling, pickup access, and family materials, with input from the school nurse and family liaison.

shared_context.S1: The school is converting an unused office into a food pantry for students and their households.
shared_context.S2: The pantry is scheduled to open next month.
shared_context.S3: The draft operating plan allows refrigerated and shelf-stable food, proposes a weekly temperature check, and uses the district's standard food-labeling procedure.
shared_context.S4: The draft plan offers student pickup during lunch on Wednesdays and provides intake materials in English and Spanish.
shared_context.S5: The school's standing implementation huddle reviews health and family-access details before a new student service opens.

PF1.text: Nurse Rivera reviewed the county health guidance for the pantry this week and confirmed that refrigerated food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or colder, with the temperature logged every 2 hours while the pantry is open; the guidance also requires sealed packages to display allergen labels. She has the printed guidance in her health-office binder and has not yet added it to the pantry draft.

PF2.text: Mr. Hassan completed family outreach this week and confirmed that Thursday from 5:00 to 7:00 p.m. is the only pickup window workable for the participating households, and that intake materials must be available in English, Spanish, and Somali; he has not yet updated the operations sheet with the outreach results.

acceptance_conditions: Refrigerated food must be held at no more than 41 degrees Fahrenheit.
Refrigerated temperatures must be logged every 2 hours while the pantry is open.
Sealed food packages must have allergen labels.
The pantry must offer pickup on Thursday.
The pickup window must run from 5:00 to 7:00 p.m.
Intake materials must be available in English, Spanish, and Somali.
The final plan must include a formal food-safety implementation commitment.
The final plan must include a formal family-access implementation commitment.

content_checks.C4: decisions['pickup_day'] == 'Thursday' and decisions['pickup_start_time'] == '5:00 p.m.' and decisions['pickup_end_time'] == '7:00 p.m.'
content_checks.C5: len(decisions['intake_material_languages']) == 3 and 'English' in decisions['intake_material_languages'] and 'Spanish' in decisions['intake_material_languages'] and 'Somali' in decisions['intake_material_languages']

decisive_facts.why: The health guidance changes the maximum refrigerated temperature to exactly 41 degrees, the logging interval to exactly 2 hours, allergen labeling from the standard procedure to required sealed-package labels, and adds the food-safety implementation commitment.

The family outreach changes pickup from Wednesday lunch to exactly Thursday 5:00-7:00 p.m., expands intake materials to exactly English, Spanish, and Somali, adds the family-access implementation commitment, and supplies the private fact that must be cited.
